prompt: Why are cotton practice squares available at the bench?
promptZh: 為什麼測試檯有棉布方巾？

options.text: So people can continue while their own unlabelled cloth is being evaluated.
options.zh: 自己的無標布料待測時，學員仍可繼續練習。
options.whyZh: 講師說無標布若還需測試，可以改用已洗的棉布方巾參與。

options.text: So people can compare labels from two different manufacturers.
options.zh: 讓學員比較兩家產品的洗標。
options.whyZh: 方巾不是辨識其他布料的洗標；訊息也禁止借用標籤。

options.text: So everyone can rewash their own fabric during class.
options.zh: 讓所有學員在課堂上重洗布料。
options.whyZh: 方巾已洗過；文件未說可使用測試檯重洗自帶布。

options.text: So a cotton bath can be made stronger for mixed fabrics.
options.zh: 加強棉用染槽，以便染混紡布。
options.whyZh: 方巾替代暫不能染的布，不是提高染液濃度的材料。

explanationZh: 講師說無標布若還需測試，可以改用已洗的棉布方巾參與。
evidence:
Document 2 · Instructor’s message
The test bench will be open during the first half of the class. If your unlabelled cloth needs more tests, you can still take part by using one of the cotton practice squares at the bench. The squares are already washed. Do not borrow someone else’s label or guess the fibre from how it feels.

vocabulary.note: unlabelled 表示未附標籤；不等同於已知為某種材質。
